code: Ontario Building Code (2024), Division B, Subsection 3.4.6 (exit stairs) and 3.3.5
comfort_guidance: Design guidance (not a Code limit): 2 x riser + tread run between about 570 and 660 mm feels natural; stairs inside dwelling units follow Part 9 with different limits.
notes: Risers and treads must be uniform within a flight; guards, handrails and landing sizes are separate requirements of Subsection 3.4.6.
